server.fixturePreparation: Committed realtime-workload.ts creates actual P1 then warms through generation one before resuming generation two; real trainer applied actions before sampler began.

analysis.interpretation: Ordinary slow steps alone exceed one percent, so excluding generation-ending computation would still fail. Sensing and world work dominate ordinary slow-step wall attribution; inference is a smaller share. Counters give attribution, not causal proof of host contention.

hostContext.scope: Read-only point snapshots before/after measurement, not synchronized continuous CPU evidence or proof that Plex caused the failed percentile.
